The Flagship Offer

VA Agency Launchpad

Your complete agency backend: built, tested & handed over.

Fixed-Scope Engagement

VA Agency Launchpad

New or scaling VA agency founders hire me to build everything on the operations side in 4–6 weeks. You focus on clients and sales. I build the machine that supports it all.

⏱ 4–6 weeks · Deliverable-based · Not a retainer

  • Recruitment Pipeline: Branded forms, Apps Script scoring, automated shortlisting & interview emails
  • Client Onboarding System: CRM, Calendly integration, welcome flows, alert panel
  • CRM Setup: Airtable or GHL configured for your exact workflow
  • Performance Dashboard: Real-time VA productivity and client analytics
  • Central Operations Hub: SOPs, training materials, dashboards, all in one page
  • AI-Powered Workflows: Email routing, classification, or qualification bots
Automation Package

Client Acquisition Pipeline: Done For You

The exact system built for MavenAide: a fully automated, end-to-end client pipeline triggered by Calendly and managed entirely from Slack.

4 workflows · 88 nodes · 0 manual CRM updates

  • WF1 Calendly Booking: Auto-creates Airtable record + Slack alert with action buttons
  • WF2 Stage Change Engine: Branded emails + real-time Slack edits at every stage
  • WF3 Slack Command Centre: Proposals, VA selection, contracts, all via Slack buttons
  • WF4 Follow-up Scheduler: Daily nudges for stale proposals and unsigned contracts
  • Airtable CRM: 13-stage Kanban, configured and ready
  • Setup Guide: Full documentation, credential checklist, activation order
